name: The St. Regis Lhasa Resort
positioning: Luxury resort in Lhasa's ancient Barkhor area, overlooking the Potala Palace, with Tibetan design touches inspired by the nearby Sera Monastery
best_for: Travelers who want a base near the Potala Palace, Jokhang Temple and Barkhor Street
Guests who value Tibetan-inspired design, a spa and an indoor pool

facts.text: The hotel is set in the ancient Barkhor area of Lhasa.
The hotel overlooks the Xizang landscape and the Potala Palace.
Rooms and suites feature motifs inspired by the nearby Sera Monastery.
The lobby has 20-foot ceilings, huge exposed beams, locally woven carpets and paintings of Tibetan nomads.
Yan Ting is a Cantonese restaurant serving Cantonese, Sichuanese, Hunanese and local dishes.
Social serves international cuisine focused on Asian and Chinese fusion.
The spa reflects the art and spirit of Xizang and offers personalized, holistic treatments.
The hotel has an indoor pool called the Golden Energy Swimming Pool.
Rooms and suites have ground heating.
Bathrooms have heated slate floors, heated toilet seats and a separate tub.
Nearby attractions include Jokhang Temple, Barkhor Street and the Potala Palace.
Self parking and valet parking are complimentary for guests.

highlights.text: Tubo Bar is on the hotel's sixth floor, with a floor-to-ceiling window overlooking the garden and the Potala.
The grounds include a spa pavilion, a meditation garden and 40-foot crimson exterior walls.
Social has an open, interactive kitchen and views of the Himalaya mountain range.
Yan Ting has six private rooms and an adjacent villa.

considerations.text: Lhasa Gonggar Airport is approximately 60 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
